criteria_snapshot.description: Technical architecture, functionality, scalability and integration capability.
Project timeline, delivery methodology, milestones and implementation team.
Pricing competitiveness, cost transparency and overall value for money.
Information security, data protection, access control and regulatory compliance.
Customer support, service commitments, references and relevant project experience.

tie_break_rule: PPI descending, submission date ascending, experience rating descending, supplier name ascending

suppliers.overall_summary: Apex Systems provides a technically mature and secure solution that aligns well with Northstar's existing SAP and Microsoft environment. While the proposal is at a higher price point than other bids, it offers high extensibility and a well-defined implementation methodology. The risks are primarily related to project dependencies and potential scope creep regarding custom SAP integrations.
risks: The 18-week implementation schedule is dependent on the buyer providing timely SAP sandbox access and clean data.
Three-year total cost is higher than other market options.
Additional costs may be incurred for storage exceeding 2 TB or custom SAP object development.
Complex legacy SAP fields are excluded from the initial integration scope pending discovery.

criteria.justification: The proposal demonstrates a robust, modern microservices architecture with clear integration paths for SAP and Microsoft ecosystems. It meets all functional requirements including workflow orchestration and auditability.
criteria.evidence: Apex Procurement Cloud uses separately deployable services for supplier master, sourcing events, document management, approvals, analytics and notification. Services run in managed Kubernetes across three availability zones.

criteria.justification: The implementation plan is detailed and structured with clear milestones. The 18-week timeline is realistic, though slightly longer than the buyer's baseline, due to the inclusion of migration rehearsals and integration testing.
criteria.evidence: Apex proposes an 18-week delivery. Weeks 1-2: discovery and solution design. Weeks 3-5: tenant setup, identity and core data model. Weeks 6-9: supplier onboarding, RFQ and approvals configuration.

criteria.justification: Pricing is transparent with a clear breakdown of one-time and recurring costs. However, the proposal explicitly notes it is not the lowest-cost option and includes potential variable costs for storage and custom SAP objects.
criteria.evidence: Three-year total before taxes INR 1,32,00,000. Storage above 2 TB is INR 1,20,000 per additional TB per year. Additional custom SAP objects are charged at INR 18,000 per consultant day.

criteria.justification: The supplier provides strong evidence of security compliance, including ISO 27001 certification, SOC 2 Type II reporting, and clear data residency in India. Disaster recovery and RTO/RPO targets align with buyer expectations.
criteria.evidence: Apex states that its operating entity holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification... Customer data is hosted in Mumbai and Hyderabad regions with encrypted cross-zone backups.

criteria.justification: The support model is comprehensive, offering 24x7 coverage for critical incidents and a named service manager. Relevant project experience is cited with two similar-sized manufacturing references.
criteria.evidence: Premium support provides 24x7 coverage for P1 incidents, 8x5 coverage for other tickets, a named service manager and quarterly service reviews.
